caption:
Throw pillows go flat because the insert is the cheap part nobody replaces.

The cover you picked out is usually fine — it's the sagging insert underneath doing the damage. Swapping inserts is the low-effort move: your existing 18x18 covers stay, the shape underneath gets fixed. It's the difference between a cushion that slumps into the corner of the couch and one that actually holds a corner.

These are 18x18 pillow inserts from Utopia Bedding, sized to fill standard 18-inch covers. They sit at 4.6 stars across 218,241 reviews — a volume that reads less like a trend and more like a staple people reorder as covers accumulate.

Keep the covers you already own and give them structure again, at $12.89.
